description: Block until the in-flight perf-monitor batch finishes, then return its ranked comparison. Use this if a batch was started another way (e.g. on the device).

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

maxWaitMs.description: Max time to wait. Default 600000 (10 min).

name: wait_for_automation
